s01.title: THE WAY DOWN
pages: Little one, the lake waits at the bottom of the world. Run with {move_left} and {move_right}. Jump with {jump}, and hold it to leap higher. Your bamboo stick swings with {attack}.

s02.title: WALLS AND ROPES
pages: Press {jump} against a wall to leap away from it, again and again. Ropes and vines will carry you: {move_up} climbs, {pound} climbs down.

s03.title: THE DASH
pages: Dash with {dash} to cross a wide gap. Touch ground or wall, and it comes back.

s04.title: A PLACE TO REST
pages: Stand beside a resting lantern and press {interact} to mend your crystals. When you fall, you wake at the last one you rested by.

s05.title: A GATE, A KEY
pages: Every region keeps a gate, and every gate wants a key. The key of the Overgrowth sleeps at the top of this ruin. Climb.

s06.title: THE FIRST GUARDIAN
pages: A crystal guardian keeps this temple. Strike it with your bamboo stick ({attack}) and it reels for a moment, its heart bare. Fall upon the heart from above. When the ground shakes, jump ({jump}).

s07.title: FIVE GUARDIANS
pages: Five crystal guardians keep the door to the lake, one in every region. Break them all, and the water will let you in.

s08.title: GROUND POUND
pages: Press {pound} in the air to fall like a stone. A guardian's heart breaks twice as fast when you land on it.

s09.title: THE RUSTWORKS
pages: Iron remembers the hands that bent it. A guardian sleeps deeper in the foundry. Find its temple, and the key that is kept beside it.

s10.title: THE SECOND KEY
pages: Climb the broken beams. The key of the Rustworks waits at the very top, where the roof used to be.

s11.title: THE SECOND GUARDIAN
pages: This one calls the ceiling down. Watch the floor: a light shows where each shard will land.

s12.title: DOUBLE JUMP
pages: Press {jump} again in the air for one more leap. Use it to reach what a single jump cannot.

s13.title: THE DROWNED WORKS
pages: The water rose and kept everything it was given. Another guardian waits in a temple the tide has not yet taken.

s14.title: THE THIRD KEY
pages: Rest your jump ({jump}) between ledges, and do not look down. The key of the Drowned Works is high and dry.

s15.title: THE THIRD GUARDIAN
pages: It is quicker than the last two. Stay in the air when it strikes, and come down on its heart.

s16.title: UNTOUCHABLE DASH
pages: Nothing can hurt you while you dash ({dash}). Once it has been used, it needs three breaths to return.

s17.title: THE BONE STACKS
pages: Whatever lived here was large. A guardian keeps the temple at the heart of the stacks, and a key rests in the ribs above.

s18.title: THE FOURTH KEY
pages: The way up is made of old bones and fewer handholds than you would like. The key of the Bone Stacks is at the top.

s19.title: THE FOURTH GUARDIAN
pages: It strikes in pairs. Dash ({dash}) through the second strike and fall upon its heart.

s20.title: HEAL IN A HEARTBEAT
pages: Hold {eat} with a full circle to mend a crystal at once, instead of in a long and dangerous moment.

s21.title: THE ASH DEEP
pages: Nothing grows here anymore. The last guardian keeps the last temple. When it falls, the lake's seal will open.

s22.title: THE LAST GUARDIAN
pages: It knows everything the others knew. You know it too. Take your time, and take the heart.

s23.title: THE LAKE
pages: Past the seal, the water is calm and nothing there will hurt you. Rest while you can.
